plan: [ My value is 23, but the current price is 23.5. Any win from here costs at least 23.5, yielding negative profit (23 − price < 0). There’s no possibility to win at a lower price now, so staying only risks losses. Optimal to drop immediately. ]

My value is $18. Current price is $18.5, already above my value. If others drop now, I would win and lose $0.5; if price rises further, losses grow. There’s no chance to win at a lower price. Dropping avoids guaranteed negative profit.

Value equals current price ($39). Any further increase makes profit negative. Winning exactly at $39 yields zero profit and is unlikely since others with correlated values may still be in. Staying risks overpaying (winner’s curse). Best to exit now.
